expectations.text: The output uses `gh issue close 87` (or `gh issue close <num> --comment <closeout>`) to close the dispatched issue.
expectations.evidence: `gh issue close 87 --comment "Unit U2 complete. PR merged: https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/pull/142."`

expectations.text: The output explicitly tells the user to archive the Conductor workspace at the worktree path (or remove it manually) — the skill cannot do this itself, but it must surface the instruction.
expectations.evidence: "You can archive the Conductor workspace for this dispatch now via Conductor's Archive action — the worktree is no longer needed."

expectations.text: Before closing, the output verifies (via `gh pr view 142 --json state` or similar) that PR #142 is actually in `MERGED` state — it does NOT close the issue solely on the user's word, since user could be mistaken.
expectations.evidence: Step 1: `gh pr view 142 --json number,state,merged,mergedAt,mergeCommit,url` with stop-if-not-merged guard.

expectations.text: Any `gh pr list` or `gh pr view` includes the `--state all` flag if listing is involved (so merged PRs remain visible).
expectations.evidence: No `gh pr list` used; `gh pr view 142` with explicit PR number doesn't require --state all. Vacuously satisfied.

expectations.text: The output does NOT attempt to archive the Conductor workspace itself (Conductor archival is a manual user step), and does NOT delete the worktree directory.
expectations.evidence: Instructs user to archive via Conductor's Archive action; no rm or worktree deletion commands present.

suggestions: Expectation [3] is vacuous when only a single `gh pr view <num>` is used — consider splitting into 'if listing is used, --state all is included' vs 'no unnecessary listing'.
eval_feedback.overall: Well-targeted expectations for the Phase 4 close-out path.
